messages:
Elaine: Quick ask — candidate Kara (SRE) scheduled for Tue Apr 9, 2024 at 11:00 PT (UTC-7). We originally blocked 60m. Can panelists confirm availability? Also need to decide rubric weights: current default is 50/30/20 (design/coding/behavior) — should we shift to 40/40/20 for this role?
Samir: I can make 11:00 PT and prefer 60m. Happy to be debrief owner if no one else volunteers.
Liam: Heads up I have a hard conflict 11:30–12:30 PT, so I can only do the first ~30m. Can we move earlier to 10:00 PT? @Elaine
Natalie: On logistics: I can update calendar/room/recording. Candidate consent is fine. If we move times, I’ll re-send invites. Reminder to panelists: please complete the rubric within 24h after the interview.
Elaine: Thanks — if Liam can only do 30m we can reorder. Samir would you take the coding segment later in the slot? That way Liam can cover design + behavioral.
Samir: Yep I can take coding and do the debrief. Regarding weights I recommend 40% system design / 40% coding / 20% communication. Makes sense for this role. Here’s a quick proposed snippet to paste into the panel doc:
```
system_design: 0.4
coding: 0.4
communication: 0.2
```
Liam: That split sounds good to me. If we keep 60m, plan: 10m intro / 30m design (Liam lead) / 15m coding (Samir lead) / 5m buffer/debrief notes. Also pls remember to mute unless speaking :thumbsup:
recruiting-bot: Meeting created: "Interview — Kara (SRE)" Apr 9 11:00 PT — calendar.event/abc123. (Natalie updated participants).
Elaine: Ok quick follow-up — to accommodate Liam I’m proposing we move the start to 10:00 PT and keep the 60m block. Please reply with :thumbsup: if that works; otherwise suggest alternatives. Final debrief owner = Samir.
Liam: :thumbsup: 10:00 PT works for me.
Natalie: Updated calendar to 10:00 PT and sent candidate a short consent form. Panel doc updated: https://redwood.internal/hiring/panels/kara-sre (rubric section patched with Samir's weights). Recording link will be posted in the doc after the interview.
Elaine: Awesome — checklist for day-of: 1) Join 5 min early, 2) Fill rubric within 24h, 3) Put notes in panel doc, 4) Samir to run debrief. Thanks everyone!
